title: Shared skills registry (v2)
description: Minimal binding contract for the root registry.json, authored 2026-08-22 when the dtcr typed queue began naming 'shared-skills-registry/v2' as a receipt schema with no contract file shipping for it (the #607 dangling-label class). Constrains the identity and the load-bearing shape the registry rule describes: a skill name appears in exactly one of the two rulings lists. Deliberately minimal — it binds what the queue's receipt claim relies on, not the registry's prose.
